holds.candidate: CDC and Contact Energy, Stratford, New Zealand
holds.reason: The council lists application 523/2026 as lodged November 9. Its property detail includes multiple East Road and Beaconsfield Road parcels. The application site point and the proposed data center footprint have not been matched.

holds.candidate: DataHub, new Port Moresby data centre, Papua New Guinea
holds.reason: The director described a built facility preparing to open on November 10. The property for this second facility remains unconfirmed in the reviewed primary sources.

holds.candidate: IFX Río de Piedras, San Pedro Sula, Honduras
holds.reason: The September 27 interview supports an operating IFX facility in San Pedro Sula. IFX labels its street address an office. A commercial directory places the facility there, but no reusable property point was verified.

holds.candidate: Telxius Edge Data Center, Cancún, Mexico
holds.reason: The September 3 operator announcement confirms the commercial facility was built. No reproducible licensed property locator was established.

The operator identifies its operating Gagarin facility on November 25 and gives the address as 1 Gortsaranayin Street. The operator’s embedded commercial map does not provide independently reusable property geometry; the queried open address and place layers yielded no matching property.

The October 21 announcement identifies a proposed 40 MW campus with a 7 MW first phase. The land announcement identifies the wider Bizerte Free Zone. A facility-specific lot or reusable property point remains outstanding.

The October 28 results attribute revenue growth through September 30 partly to the M-VAULT 4 expansion. The operator places the facility in Qatar Science and Technology Park, which hosts multiple facilities. Its corporate office does not identify this property.
The INX-ZA host directory gives 10 Walters Avenue, while OADC’s July 2026 brochure gives 19 Walters Street for the facility. The street numbers have not been tied to the same property.
The current exchange directory gives East Coast House at 314 Umhlanga Rocks Drive. OADC’s facility sheet instead gives 3 Sugar Close, 103 Gateway. The two property addresses require reconciliation.
The current operator brochure lists 22 Electron Avenue, while the exchange lists 18 Electron Avenue. A parcel or operator map confirming the same property is needed.
